leaves.name: torusRankZero
leaves.doc: GLUE (nos-converse): Serre-Tate 1968 section 2, the torsion count: a semistable Neron model whose generic fibre has inertia-trivial m-torsion for infinitely many m prime to p has abelian identity component in the geometric special fibre.
leaves.source: Serre-Tate 1968 section 2 (proof of Thm 1); glue: Neron property, [m] etale on smooth group schemes (BLR 7.3/2), torsion count on semi-abelian varieties, finite component group, equidimensionality
